newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria issues 8.5 bln levs 7-yr floater T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria issues 8.5 bln levs 7-yr floater T-bonds.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry has issued 8.5 billion levs of seven-year floating interest T-bonds to cover payments to depositors in banks declared insolvent by the court, the central bank said.
The bonds were placed with the State Savings Bank (SSB) under a State Deposit Guarantee law approved last year, a central bank statement said.

The paper bears a semi-annual coupon, which is set equal to the central bank main interest rate for the period to maturity and is adjusted each time the rate is changed. The main rate is now set at 5.5 percent annually.
The principal is payable in seven equal annual instalments until maturity.

The new issue adds to previous six issues of seven-year T-bonds worth a total of 16.7 billion levs and placed with the SSB to compensate depositors in banks, which the central bank had sought to close down, Finance Ministry figures showed.
Details of the issue follow: Number BG2041897229
